output.question: Has CDW announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. In July 2026 CDW confirmed a new round of layoffs, but it did not say how many employees were affected. The only page I could open that confirms this is a secondary write-up from Itz Big (July 18, 2026). It quotes a CDW spokesperson saying the company 'recently made organizational changes—which included coworker reductions—to sharpen our operating discipline.' The same article links the cuts to CDW's AI-first 'Geared For Growth' initiative, which targets up to $200 million in cost savings. CRN appears to have broken the story: its post on X says 'CDW has initiated a new round of layoffs.' I could not open the CRN article itself. CDW has also cut jobs before, including 450 to 750 employees in April 2023.

key_facts.fact: CDW confirmed layoffs in July 2026 as part of a broader cost-cutting effort.
A CDW spokesperson said the company made organizational changes that included coworker reductions. CDW declined to say how many employees were affected.
The layoffs follow CDW's 'Geared For Growth' AI-first initiative, which targets up to $200 million in cost savings.
CDW previously laid off between 450 and 750 employees in April 2023.

passages.quote: CDW has confirmed layoffs as part of a broader cost-cutting effort
recently made organizational changes—which included coworker reductions—to sharpen our operating discipline

caveats: CDW has not disclosed how many people were cut. A figure of about 700 circulates online, but it comes from forum speculation and is unverified.

I could not open the original CRN article or any primary CDW source, such as a press release, SEC filing or WARN notice. The confirmation rests on a secondary article quoting a spokesperson, plus a CRN post on X that I saw only in a search snippet.

Search snippets said the 'Geared for Growth' program was disclosed on CDW's May 6, 2026 Q1 earnings call and targets $100M–$200M in annual run-rate savings by 2027–2028. I did not check this against the transcript.
Anonymous posts on TheLayoff.com describe other cuts in early 2026. These are unverified.
I found no reports of layoffs after July 2026, but I can't rule out later rounds.
